moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Tesla has no government contracts… SpaceX gov’t revenue <10% this quarter, <5% next year. Happy to cancel any that gov’t doesn’t want. Just say the word!
moments.why: Musk’s bold post downplays federal dependency amid Democratic control, directly challenging critics and driving huge buzz in finance/tech circles.

moments.author: The White House
moments.quote: It is the official policy of the United States government that there are only two genders: male & female.
moments.why: A provocative stance on gender policy from the official account is fueling heated debates and trending across political demographics—including men 25‑45.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Happy to cancel any [SpaceX contracts] that the government doesn’t want. Just say the word!
moments.why: That punchy line became a meme moment — Musk offering to drop contracts on demand resonated with audiences across tech and politics.
